headline: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Subsequent to fulfilment of the Conditions Precedent under the BTA the transaction has been consummated with effect from today i.e., October 01, 2026.'.
